name: campus_guide_offers_only_basic_lands
notes: M3 mapper. Printed: 'When this creature enters, you may search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, then shuffle and put that card on top.' Seat 0's library holds a nonbasic Desert (set up first, so it would be the first card offered), a Forest and a creature. Campus Guide enters and seat 0 searches (fire), asking for the Desert: it is not a basic land card, so the search can only find the Forest, which ends on top of the library after the shuffle.
